title: frame-transact
tagline: A frame that interacts with an example contract with multiple parameters by utilizing states and finally the tx directly on the frame, also adheres to the openframe standard
description:
A frame that interacts with an example contract with multiple parameters by utilizing states and finally the tx directly on the frame, also adheres to the openframe standard - using onchain coinbase sdk and nextjs

did face alot of issues with dynamic sdk due to which we had to drop integrating them into our use case
